summary: Strategy Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for its Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC Stock) ATM offering up to $21B. The supplement amends the dividend payment cadence from monthly to twice monthly following stockholder approval at the 2026 annual meeting. No shares are being newly sold; no price, premium, or terms change other than the dividend schedule. The STRC Stock trades on Nasdaq under STRC. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment with no special situation triggering event.
